review.independentReview: Owner-reported defect: mattpocock_execute rejected an omitted workflowId while mattpocock_delegate accepted it, so the convention the injected protocol teaches failed with a message that pushed the model to invent an id. Fixed by normalizing omission to null, naming the null alternative, and stating the shapes the descriptions only implied; no behaviour changed beyond accepting that omission. The host upgrade to 0.2.1-alpha.2 was found to break 167 beta-era bridge assertions, none of them plugin defects; the suite now splits the canonical and compatibility host roots instead of weakening any assertion.
